pages.text: Hold wool and right-click the $(item)Spinning Wheel$() for three $(item)Yarn$().
pages.title: Spinning

pages.text: Brew a sizing in a cooking pot and pour it into an empty cauldron to make a $(item)Sizing Vat$().$(li)$(item)Wheat Sizing$(): four wheat. ★3$(li)$(item)Silk Sizing$(): wheat and Spider Silk. ★5$(li)$(item)Arcane Sizing$(): wheat and Arcane Dust. ★7$(br2)Yarn (or string) comes out as $(item)Sized Yarn$() of the sizing's ★.
pages.title: Sizing

pages.text: Each vat takes four pieces a batch and uses a level of liquid. Better liquids take longer: 2 minutes at ★3, 3 at ★5, 4 at ★7. Right-click with an empty hand to take the batch out, or to see how long it has left.
pages.title: The Vat
